newsitem.title: USA: Alexion gets two transplant patents.
newsitem.headline: Alexion gets two transplant patents.

text.p: Alexion Pharmaceuticals Inc said Tuesday that the U.S. Patent and Trademark Office issued to Alexion two patents related to the company's xenotransplantation program.
Xenotransplantation refers to the transplantation of non-human organs and tissues into patients.
The rapid rejection of xenotransplants is generally believed to be mediated by naturally occurring antibodies in the patient.

The company said that genetic engineering of porcine cells, tissues and organs with human complement inhibitors may represent a highly effective means to protect such foreign cells, tissues and organs from rapid destruction by the human immune system and thereby provide xenotransplantation products.

The U.S. patents cover both the nucleic acid and protein compositions of novel chimeric bifunctional human complement inhibitors used to genetically engineer mammalian cells, tissues and organs for xenotransplantation.
